name: Clarify
description: Clarify lets agents read signals, time series and events from the industrial data of the signed-in Clarify organization. Each user signs in to their own Clarify account through the browser.

prompts.text: How did the temperature signals at this site change over the last 24 hours?
Which signals moved outside their normal range this week?
Find the signals that measure pump pressure.

apps.name: Clarify
apps.description: Industrial signals, time series, and events, over Clarify's MCP server with browser sign-in.
